summary: Short arterial kerb on Moggill Road, no parked cars and no pull-off.
reasons: No shoulder, kerb meets live lane

drivers.seclusion: Dental and kindergarten buildings 14-26 m; no dwelling within 50 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb is the edge of a busy lane beside a verge and fenced car park; no room to pull off.
drivers.traffic: Busy multi-lane arterial near a junction.
drivers.convention: No cars parked along this kerb; no signs mapped.

sun_shade: Open at the kerb; trees shade the verge to the south.
